d: Long, wavy mint-green hair with thick bangs frames a mature, young adult face featuring sharp, narrow mint-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt under a black open jacket, a black high-waisted mini skirt with silver buckles and straps, black tights, and black high-heeled boots. Behind the figure looms a massive, monstrous creature made of jagged, dark grey stone with glowing cyan cracks and large wings.
